name: @repo/pi-agent
description: Interactive pi TUI with monkey-patch hooks — forces model loading from .pi/agent/models.json, delegates everything else to the official pi main().

scripts.//deploy: 4 modes — read docs BEFORE running: docs/deploy-cwd-trust.md (self-contained packaging), docs/deploy-readonly.md (default chmod a-w freeze), docs/deploy-single-binary.md (--exe), docs/deploy-efficiency.md (incremental warm rebuild). Mode flags: --bundle (default), --snapshot, --standalone, --exe. Also see the mode table in scripts/deploy.ts header. Run via `bun run deploy[:mode]` from this dir.
